description: The chart illustrates task counts by language-family group, with each group showing how often the outcome is labeled as “better” for mBERT, “better” for XLM-R, or “same,” as indicated by the legend. The horizontal axis contains the categorical language-family labels ordered left to right as IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic, with no explicit axis label; the vertical axis is a linear numeric scale labeled “task count,” ranging from 0 to 40 with tick marks at 0, 10, 20, 30, and 40. For each category, three adjacent bars are shown: a light gray-blue bar for mBERT, a darker blue bar for XLM-R, and a green bar for same. Approximate bar heights by category are: IE-Baltic (mBERT ~0, XLM-R ~10, same ~7), IE-Germanic (mBERT ~4, XLM-R ~18, same ~22), IE-Indic (mBERT ~1, XLM-R ~5, same ~4), IE-Romance (mBERT ~4, XLM-R ~13, same ~30), IE-Slavic (mBERT ~12, XLM-R ~39, same ~28), IE-other (mBERT ~1, XLM-R ~6, same ~8), Isolate (mBERT ~1, XLM-R ~5, same ~1), Semitic (mBERT ~0, XLM-R ~7, same ~1), and Uralic (mBERT ~1, XLM-R ~14, same ~5). The bars are grouped side-by-side within each category (not stacked), there is no visible sorting by bar height beyond the fixed category order, and no individual bars appear specially emphasized beyond the color coding and the legend.
